newsitem.title: USA: Individual in talks to sell Freeloader unit.
newsitem.headline: Individual in talks to sell Freeloader unit.

text.p: Individual Inc Thursday said it is in preliminary talks to sell its FreeLoader subsidiary, which it acquired in June 1996 for $38 million in cash and stock.
The company said that discussions have begun with potential investors to buy the unit, which makes a popular off-line internet browsing tool.

In the interim, FreeLoader will continue operating at its existing level of expenditures. For the fourth quarter, the FreeLoader operating expenses included in merger and disposition expenses were $1.5 million, the company said.
The company hopes to finalize a transaction by the end of the first quarter of 1997.

Individual President and Chief Executive Officer Michael Kolowich said, "...there should be no significant additional losses realized upon the sale of the business, other than the ongoing operating costs and other costs related to the ultimate disposition."

In December, Individual reached an agreement with Yosi Amram, founder and former chief executive officer of Individual, over issues relating to his resignation from the firm. The company began a search for a new president while Amram was on leave of absence.
